content: Exponential backoff formula in Elixir (pure, no I/O): delay = min(cap, base * 2^attempt). Use Bitwise.bsl(1, attempt) for 2^attempt (pure integer arithmetic). Round to integer milliseconds. Tesla uses: factor = Bitwise.bsl(1, attempt); max_sleep = min(cap, base * factor). For pure Lifecycle module: def compute_delay(attempt, base, cap) do min(cap, base * Bitwise.bsl(1, attempt)) end. No :math module needed — Bitwise is pure integer. Default values to consider: base 500ms, cap 30_000ms (30 seconds), max_retries 3-5.
